datasets.name: 0a3face8
queryLines:
WITH ingresos_vendedor AS (
  SELECT
    v.seller_id,
    v.nombre_vendedor,
    ROUND(SUM(d.price), 2) AS ingresos_totales
  FROM
    `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_detalles` d
      INNER JOIN `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_pedidos` p
        ON d.order_id = p.order_id
      INNER JOIN `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_productos` pr
        ON d.product_id = pr.product_id
      INNER JOIN `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_categorias` cat
        ON pr.product_category_name = cat.product_category_name
      INNER JOIN `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_vendedores` v
        ON d.seller_id = v.seller_id
  WHERE
    cat.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    v.seller_id,
    v.nombre_vendedor
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    LPAD(CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ingresos_totales DESC) AS STRING), 2, '0'),
    '. ',
    nombre_vendedor
  ) AS nombre_vendedor,
  ingresos_totales
FROM
  ingresos_vendedor
ORDER BY
  ingresos_totales DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 103c13ae
queryLines:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE default.gold_kpi_02_top_vendedores AS

WITH ingresos_vendedor AS (
    SELECT
        v.seller_id,
        v.nombre_vendedor,
        ROUND(SUM(d.price), 2) AS ingresos_totales
    FROM silver_detalles d
    INNER JOIN silver_pedidos p
        ON d.order_id = p.order_id
    INNER JOIN silver_productos pr
        ON d.product_id = pr.product_id
    INNER JOIN silver_categorias cat
        ON pr.product_category_name = cat.product_category_name
    INNER JOIN silver_vendedores v
        ON d.seller_id = v.seller_id
    WHERE cat.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        v.seller_id,
        v.nombre_vendedor
),
ranking AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY ingresos_totales DESC
        ) AS position,
        seller_id,
        nombre_vendedor,
        ingresos_totales
    FROM ingresos_vendedor
)
SELECT
    position,
    CONCAT(
        LPAD(CAST(position AS STRING), 2, '0'),
        '. ',
        nombre_vendedor
    ) AS nombre_vendedor,
    ingresos_totales
FROM ranking
WHERE position <= 10
ORDER BY position;

SELECT *
FROM default.gold_kpi_02_top_vendedores;

datasets.name: 9ac1d4c1
queryLines:
WITH ingresos_mensuales AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(p.order_purchase_timestamp) AS anio,
    MONTH(p.order_purchase_timestamp) AS mes,
    ROUND(SUM(d.price), 2) AS ingresos
  FROM
    `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_detalles` d
      INNER JOIN `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_pedidos` p
        ON d.order_id = p.order_id
      INNER JOIN `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_productos` pr
        ON d.product_id = pr.product_id
      INNER JOIN `workspace`.`olist_nuevo`.`silver_categorias` cat
        ON pr.product_category_name = cat.product_category_name
  WHERE
    cat.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    YEAR(p.order_purchase_timestamp),
    MONTH(p.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
comparacion AS (
  SELECT
    actual.anio,
    actual.mes,
    actual.ingresos AS ingresos_actuales,
    anterior.ingresos AS ingresos_anteriores
  FROM
    ingresos_mensuales actual
      LEFT JOIN ingresos_mensuales anterior
        ON anterior.anio
          = CASE
            WHEN actual.mes = 1 THEN actual.anio - 1
            ELSE actual.anio
          END
        AND anterior.mes
          = CASE
            WHEN actual.mes = 1 THEN 12
            ELSE actual.mes - 1
          END
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(
    LPAD(CAST(mes AS STRING), 2, '0'),
    '. ',
    CASE mes
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Ene'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Abr'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul'
      WHEN 8 THEN 'Ago'
      WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep'
      WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct'
      WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov'
      WHEN 12 THEN 'Dic'
    END,
    ' ',
    CAST(anio AS STRING)
  ) AS periodo,
  ROUND(ingresos_actuales, 2) AS ingresos_actuales,
  ROUND(ingresos_anteriores, 2) AS ingresos_anteriores,
  ROUND(ingresos_actuales - ingresos_anteriores, 2) AS diferencia_ingresos,
  ROUND(
    (ingresos_actuales - ingresos_anteriores) / NULLIF(ingresos_anteriores, 0) * 100,
    2
  ) AS variacion_porcentual
FROM
  comparacion
ORDER BY
  anio,
  mes

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE default.gold_kpi_05_variacion_mensual AS

WITH ingresos_mensuales AS (
    SELECT
        YEAR(p.order_purchase_timestamp) AS anio,
        MONTH(p.order_purchase_timestamp) AS mes,
        ROUND(SUM(d.price), 2) AS ingresos

    FROM silver_detalles d

    INNER JOIN silver_pedidos p
        ON d.order_id = p.order_id

    INNER JOIN silver_productos pr
        ON d.product_id = pr.product_id

    INNER JOIN silver_categorias cat
        ON pr.product_category_name = cat.product_category_name

    WHERE cat.product_category_name_english IS NOT NULL

    GROUP BY
        YEAR(p.order_purchase_timestamp),
        MONTH(p.order_purchase_timestamp)
),

comparacion AS (
    SELECT
        actual.anio,
        actual.mes,
        actual.ingresos AS ingresos_actuales,
        anterior.ingresos AS ingresos_anteriores

    FROM ingresos_mensuales actual

    LEFT JOIN ingresos_mensuales anterior
        ON anterior.anio = CASE
            WHEN actual.mes = 1 THEN actual.anio - 1
            ELSE actual.anio
        END

        AND anterior.mes = CASE
            WHEN actual.mes = 1 THEN 12
            ELSE actual.mes - 1
        END
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY anio, mes
    ) AS position,

    anio,
    mes,

    CONCAT(
        LPAD(CAST(mes AS STRING), 2, '0'),
        '. ',
        CASE mes
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Ene'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Feb'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Mar'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Abr'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'May'
            WHEN 6 THEN 'Jun'
            WHEN 7 THEN 'Jul'
            WHEN 8 THEN 'Ago'
            WHEN 9 THEN 'Sep'
            WHEN 10 THEN 'Oct'
            WHEN 11 THEN 'Nov'
            WHEN 12 THEN 'Dic'
        END,
        ' ',
        CAST(anio AS STRING)
    ) AS periodo,

    ROUND(ingresos_actuales, 2) AS ingresos_actuales,

    ROUND(ingresos_anteriores, 2) AS ingresos_anteriores,

    ROUND(
        ingresos_actuales - ingresos_anteriores, 2
    ) AS diferencia_ingresos,

    ROUND(
        (ingresos_actuales - ingresos_anteriores)
        / NULLIF(ingresos_anteriores, 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS variacion_porcentual

FROM comparacion

ORDER BY anio, mes;

SELECT *
FROM default.gold_kpi_05_variacion_mensual
ORDER BY position;

datasets.name: 7ca9f13a
queryLines:
WITH ingresos_estado AS (
    SELECT
        customer_state AS estado,
        SUM(price) AS ingresos_totales
    FROM ef.ventas
    GROUP BY customer_state
),
ranking AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY ingresos_totales DESC
        ) AS posicion,
        estado,
        ingresos_totales
    FROM ingresos_estado
)
SELECT
    CONCAT(
        LPAD(CAST(posicion AS STRING), 2, '0'),
        '. ',
        estado
    ) AS estado,
    ROUND(ingresos_totales, 2) AS ingresos,
    ROUND(
        ingresos_totales * 100.0 / SUM(ingresos_totales) OVER (),
        2
    ) AS porcentaje_ventas
FROM ranking
WHERE posicion <= 10
ORDER BY posicion ASC;
